en: Black‑and‑white image of a European old town street dominated by a tall church tower with a very slender, steep spire. The tower has a square base with arched windows and belfry openings, and it is flanked by narrow historic townhouses with steep, tiled roofs lining a cobbled street. Trees are visible on the left side and a few early‑20th‑century cars are parked along the street. There is no visible printed caption on the image side.
